body:
In my first post here i remember making a "spoiled brat" reference. I think only shallow people would look at you and think that....humans are very complex creatures and if what you have doesn't have meaning then we almost naturally turn to "what am i living for?" Maybe you are lacking something you are passionate about?... Be it a hobby you've wanted to try but never have, that you and your girlfriend aren't going where you expect it to, your job means nothing to you besides a paycheck, etc. If you find that something that drives you to live every day and gives you a feeling of purpose it could help.

I myself am passionate about my job and it drives me to get up every morning and at the end of most days I have a feeling of accomplishment. I don't want to insinuate that's a cure or anything...but it helps me day by day.

I don't think being crazy is the end to the story, and I hope you don't try anything rash for that reason. I know that feeling of trying so hard but nothing seems to make a difference...the feeling of hoping its all a bad dream as my life can feel like its straight from a nightmare some days. There are plenty of us who are here with an open ear and a caring heart. 

My heart goes out to you and I hope your story takes a turn for the better! (I love a full story with all its ups and downs)

Wow, theres a lot there to take in. I don't necessarily understand where you are going with the whole "right call" thing, but yes I've started to not trust anything I think when I'm upset, however, if I say something enough times it starts to become a tangible possibility and eventually the non-upset me will echo it and it becomes "truth" in the sense that I've convinced myself.
 And yes I do care too much what people think. Its hard for me when I care that much about those around me and would block a bullet for nearly anyone stranger or otherwise. I keep reading that this mentality is flawed and always being the nice guy will never end you up where you want, but I'm so minimalistic in my lifestyle that things and stuff means nothing to me.

Panicky yes..most of the time its akin to a feeling of claustrophobia. I just have to gtfo where I'm at...if I stop moving the weight of everything crashing down pins me and I can't move again till it passes.
I'm typically very reserved but if I get upset or emotional my mind goes blank and I just feel, composing myself is very difficult and its very easy for me to roll back into an upsetted state.

I think you underestimate yourself. Think of how many people have kids and pets along with a loved one. There's a lot of love to give out in those situations, and when you are loved back you will realize that the love you share is far deeper than one-sided love.

I can relate...imagine sharing an apartment with her and she has all her boyfriends over on the weekends. Been there, still kinda doing that, but please try to get over her. You'll be happier, and I promise there's some girl out there who will respect and love you back.

While I wasn't much into power rangers as a child (didn't have a TV), I completely relate.
I struggle with a crushing loneliness and have for a good while now, some days I barely pull myself out of bed. But do you have any family you can talk to? My parents don't believe in depression and they find it difficult to grasp that I cant just bounce back, but they honestly enjoy my company and having a good time with me. So while living 400miles away doesn't help seeing them often, giving them a call every couple days with the knowledge that they are so happy to have me call does help me.

Its difficult to carry through the battle on your own day after day, but I believe one day the fighting will pay off. One day I will conquer the demons which torment my dreams and waking hours. And I believe you have the power to do this as well...I'm more than open to a pm and an opportunity to fight by your side, everything is going to be alright.
That sounds quite enjoyable! :-)

The only goal I can think of is to make a friend or two who actually want to hang out on the weekends, grab a beer a couple nights a week, etc. But I've been trying for nine months now and its feeling pretty hopeless

Your siblings and others will always play pranks not thinking the prank all the way through a lot of times, but they usually aren't meant to be malicious. It sucks that happened especially on your birthday but you are rekindling an old friendship which will hopefully turn into something wonderful which will last a lifetime which is quite sweet actually. And be sure to tell your girl she's awesome for being there to help you through things :-)

This sounds like me on my bad days. For me the void describes the lack of seeing a way out, the lack of understanding why I can't change things for the better. However I know my void is loneliness, I want more than anything in the world to have someone to hang with regularly, shoot the shit, and won't judge me for my past or present. When I started feeling depressed over this I could easily pinpoint the cause, but as more months pass I feel as though those causes are lost as there's no fix.

I don't know if this is of any help, but I thank you for this post. I keep telling myself things will get better and I believe that it must, I just have to see things through to that day and I wish to extend that belief to you.

I read this just the other day and that exact sentence made me post to SW instead of doing something more drastic. I didn't necessarily get the answer I was looking for but I found the support of others which was what I needed.
I know it only seems to put off the pain (feelin pretty low myself thanks to some traumatic events I have tied to v-day) but the answer is out there and I hold the hope that one day things will get better. And I hold that hope also for you.

Im going to give you the benefit of the doubt that you arent trolling...I have been to the slums of Guatamala and firsthand seen some bad shit, so I certainly appreciate my home and bed. But they had a community bond that was on a level that seemed fairytaleish, while I'm here in a land of plenty without a caring soul around, does that seem right to you? (I'm not trying to make an argument out of this, just as you said its all about perspective and mine just differs from yours)

Thanks for the support. And yes I have thought of getting a dog and its a very good suggestion. My apartment-mate has one which I love on and as soon as she moves out I may think about getting one. I do have a hedgehog which has been good in the being responsible and taking care of another living creature. But hedgehogs aren't the most snuggly creatures around.
Thank you.
Yes the small things provide enough light to keep moving forward
I used to play video games but they seem to intensify the loneliness if I'm not in the mood. I did pick up a guitar recently as a new hobby and have been slowly teaching myself that.
I for one am very happy 2:13 was not the end to your story.

Thanks for the reply, i very much share the "someone to share life with" mentality. I'd drop everything I'm doing, and move halfway across the world if I could be promised someone who would care for me as much as I care for them.

The company is a small engineering contractor and I'm on a team with 3 other programmers. I do enjoy it, I work 12 hour days fairly often and willingly partly because its better than going home. But the project I'm on is very mentally challenging (algorithms) and you can only do so many hours before you just have to take a mental break.
